title: Soylu Vahşinin İzinde: Keşifler ve Bir Efsanenin Doğuşu
author: Töre Sivrioğlu
description: For centuries, Western thought has pursued the “Noble Savage,” a romanticised figure embodying an imagined purity beyond the laws, property and constraints of civilisation. Tracing this enduring myth from ancient Mesopotamian tablets to the Age of Exploration, Töre Sivrioğlu examines how societies have repeatedly constructed the “other” from Enkidu and Rousseau’s pre-property human to Magellan’s “giants” and Montaigne’s “cannibals.” Blending intellectual inquiry with vivid historical storytelling, In Search of the Noble Savage offers a provocative cultural history of mythmaking and the colonial imagination while reconsidering the origins of property, warfare and gendered social order, and challenging modern assumptions about civilisation and human nature.
original_title: Soylu Vahşinin İzinde: Keşifler ve Bir Efsanenin Doğuşu
english_title: In Search of the Noble Savage: Explorations and the Making of a Myth
